articles.summary: At Ardmore, a strong culture is shaped not only by how we work together each day, but also by how colleagues support the communities around them. Across Cork, Houston and the wider maritime sector, teams have put Ardmore's One Team ethos into action through volunteering, fundraising and industry collaboration. From helping to redirect surplus food Discover how Ardmore colleagues are supporting local communities and the wider maritime sector through volunteering, fundraising and industry collaboration.
articles.title: Ardmore colleagues supporting local communities
